import ctypes

def assert_test():
    # Load the libraries in the correct order
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    # Define the strdup function signature
    gsl.strdup.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p]
    gsl.strdup.restype = ctypes.c_char_p

    # Test cases
    input_str = b"Hello, GSL!"
    duplicated_str = gsl.strdup(input_str)
    assert duplicated_str == b"Hello, GSL!", f"Test failed: Expected 'Hello, GSL!', got {duplicated_str}"

    input_str = b"Python ctypes"
    duplicated_str = gsl.strdup(input_str)
    assert duplicated_str == b"Python ctypes", f"Test failed: Expected 'Python ctypes', got {duplicated_str}"

    input_str = b""
    duplicated_str = gsl.strdup(input_str)
    assert duplicated_str == b"", f"Test failed: Expected an empty string, got {duplicated_str}"

    print("All tests passed successfully.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
